companies.name: Arrakis
companies.location_text: London (and Paris), per the company and press; registered office at B1 Vantage Park, Bristol is a formation-agent address
companies.one_liner: Arrakis is an industrial AI company whose platform deploys AI agents into mission-critical operations for enterprises in sectors such as aerospace and defense, energy, engineering and construction, shipping, and telecommunications, without requiring them to replace their existing systems.
companies.headcount_source: Fortune and The Next Web report approximately 15 employees as of July 2026, with the company planning to triple headcount; the UK company was incorporated 19 December 2025, so it is about seven months old. Treat as a reported figure at the low end of this bucket.

founders.name: Haroun Beltaifa
founders.background: One of Arrakis's four named co-founders; The Next Web reports he previously worked at Palantir.

founders.name: Mikhail Galkov
founders.background: One of Arrakis's four named co-founders; The Next Web reports he previously worked at Delivery Hero.

founders.name: Romain Fouilland
founders.background: One of Arrakis's four named co-founders; The Next Web reports he previously worked at Palantir.

companies.name: Tyred
companies.location_text: 5th Floor Palladium House, 1-4 Argyll Street, London, W1F 7TA
companies.one_liner: Tyred is a London company that sends bike mechanics to riders on demand and services shared e-bike fleets, including roughly 50,000 of Lime's bikes in London, while building a connected 'ownership' platform that bundles bike repairs, maintenance, insurance, warranty, and finance.
companies.headcount_source: No public headcount figure; qualitative estimate of the core team for a 2022-founded seed startup that has raised GBP2.5m and is hiring engineers. Its field mechanic operation is larger (100,000+ bikes serviced in the past year and a roughly 50,000-bike Lime fleet in London) and is likely partly a contractor network, so this bucket reflects the core company only and is uncertain (BikeBiz and ZAG Daily, 16 July 2026).

founders.name: Daniel Bursztynski
founders.background: Named in the July 2026 seed-round press coverage as a co-founder of Tyred and its chief technology officer.

founders.name: Lancelot Hoare
founders.background: Co-founder and CEO of Tyred; the company's sole Companies House-registered director (TYRED LTD, 14293054), appointed on incorporation in August 2022.

founders.name: Nikita Baranov
founders.background: Named in the July 2026 seed-round press coverage as a co-founder of Tyred and its chief operating officer.

companies.name: Valarian
companies.location_text: Unit 4.04, 175 High Holborn, Tottenham Court Road, London, WC1V 7AA
companies.one_liner: Valarian builds sovereign infrastructure, delivered as a hardened Kubernetes control layer called ACRA, that lets governments, defence, and regulated enterprises run high-consequence AI and other sensitive workloads while keeping control over where their data lives and who can access it.
companies.headcount_source: Press reported about 31 staff in London around the Series A, 2026-07; consistent with the 26-50 bucket and the leadership team named on valarian.com/about. The 31 figure is press-reported and was not independently re-verified in this pass.

founders.name: Joshua (Josh) McLaughlin
founders.background: A retired US Army officer and Ranger who previously led new market expansion at Palantir before co-founding Valarian.

founders.name: Maximilian (Max) Buchan
founders.background: An early employee at digital asset manager CoinShares, where he helped launch one of the first publicly listed bitcoin exchange-traded products, before founding Valarian.

companies.name: Meticulous
companies.one_liner: Meticulous makes an AI testing tool that records real usage of a web app and automatically writes and maintains its end-to-end UI tests, catching visual and behavioural regressions so engineering teams do not have to hand-write frontend tests.
companies.headcount_source: Bucketed estimate. The company's Y Combinator profile lists a team of roughly 15, and the live Ashby careers board shows 7 open roles (5 London, 2 San Francisco), 2026-07.

founders.name: Gabriel Spencer-Harper
founders.background: Co-founder and CEO of Meticulous, and its sole director on the Companies House register; previously an engineer at Dropbox and Opendoor.

founders.name: Quentin Spencer-Harper
founders.background: Co-founder and CTO of Meticulous and Gabriel's brother; spent about a decade leading frontend engineering on Palantir's Foundry product before starting the company.

companies.name: Prolo
companies.one_liner: Prolo is an AI-powered procurement platform for small and mid-sized construction firms, helping builders source, compare, and buy materials, equipment, and hire from a nationwide network of more than 185 supplier brands at competitive trade rates.
companies.headcount_source: No headcount figure published in the funding press; the live public team page (https://prolo.io/team) lists 14 named team members, so bucketed as 11-25. Verified 2026-07-27.

founders.name: James Morris-Manuel
founders.background: Previously founded Virtual Walkthrough, scaled it into a European market leader and led its acquisition by spatial data company Matterport, then served as EMEA Managing Director at Matterport, establishing its London regional headquarters; registered at Companies House as James David Morris-Manuel, a director since 25 June 2024.

companies.name: Kord
companies.location_text: 853-859 Salisbury House 29 Finsbury Circus, London, EC2M 5QQ
companies.one_liner: Kord is an FCA-regulated platform that combines identity verification, AML and compliance checks, client onboarding and e-signing, and payment processing into a single system for regulated industries such as estate agents, law firms, and conveyancers.
companies.headcount_source: Estimate only; no public headcount figure found. Inferred from Series A stage, revenue reported growing from about GBP600k to GBP4m in a year, 100+ paying customers, and two product lines. Treat as an estimate, not a confirmed number.

founders.name: James Owusu

companies.headcount_source: About page states a team of over 20 people, based in Farringdon, London (whering.co/about, verified 2026-07-12). Bucketed as 11-25.

founders.name: Bianca Rangecroft
founders.background: Founder and CEO of Whering and a director since its incorporation on 10 June 2020; started the company to solve her own wardrobe-management problem and has led it to 10m users.

companies.name: geoSurge
companies.location_text: 167-169 Great Portland Street Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF

companies.headcount_source: No absolute figure published; soft estimate from a just-closed $12m seed with active hiring and press noting headcount doubled since a 2025 stealth exit. Treat as an estimate; it could be under 10.
